notes.title: New game mode and new particles
notes.content:
System Update

Now you can look around using mouse


New Game Mode "Box"

The ball shape change to box when you enter.

 - you can use grappling hook in the box map.



New custom color option "Brightness"

notes.title: First update!!
notes.content:
More Maps!!
Before the update, there was only one  maps total, but I added two more maps in the game.



More Particles!!
There are 9 particles in total, you can get them by finishing the map, or finding easter eggs.


UI Update

Fixed Ui. Now it look much better
